019package org.apache.wiki.ui;
020
021import org.apache.wiki.api.core.Context;
022import org.apache.wiki.api.engine.Initializable;
023import org.apache.wiki.modules.ModuleManager;
024import org.apache.wiki.auth.AuthorizationManager;
025import org.apache.wiki.auth.permissions.PagePermission;
026import org.apache.wiki.util.HttpUtil;
027import org.apache.wiki.api.core.Context;
028import org.apache.wiki.api.core.Page;
029 import org.apache.wiki.api.engine.Initializable;
030import org.apache.wiki.auth.AuthorizationManager;
031import org.apache.wiki.auth.permissions.PagePermission;
032import org.apache.wiki.auth.permissions.PermissionFactory;
033import jakarta.servlet.jsp.PageContext;
034
035
036/**
037 *  Defines an editor manager.  An editor can be added by adding a suitable JSP file under templates/default/editors
038 *  If you want your editor to include any scripts or something, you can simply request it by adding the following in your
039 *  {@code ini/jspwiki_module.xml}:
040 *
041 *  <pre>
042 *  &lt;modules>
043 *   &lt;editor name="myeditor">
044 *       &lt;author>Janne Jalkanen&lt;/author>
045 *       &lt;script>foo.js&lt;/script>
046 *       &lt;stylesheet>foo.css&lt;/stylesheet>
047 *       &lt;path>editors/myeditor.jsp&lt;/path>
048 *   &lt;/editor>
049 *  &lt;/modules>
050 *  </pre>
051 *
052 *  @since 2.4
053 */
054public interface EditorManager extends ModuleManager, Initializable {
055
056    /** The property name for setting the editor. Current value is "jspwiki.editor" - not used anymore: replaced by defaultpref.template.editor */
057    String PROP_EDITORTYPE = "jspwiki.editor";
058
059    /** Parameter for changing editors at run-time */
060    String PARA_EDITOR = "editor";
061
062    /** Known name for the plain wikimarkup editor. */
063    String EDITOR_PLAIN = "plain";
064
065    /** Known name for the preview editor component. */
066    String EDITOR_PREVIEW = "preview";
067
068    /** Known attribute name for storing the user edited text inside a HTTP parameter. */
069    String REQ_EDITEDTEXT = "_editedtext";
070
071    /** Known attribute name for storing the user edited text inside a session or a page context */
072    String ATTR_EDITEDTEXT = REQ_EDITEDTEXT;
073
074    /**
075     *  Returns an editor for the current context.  The editor names are matched in a case insensitive manner.  At the moment, the only
076     *  place that this method looks in is the property file, but in the future this will also look at user preferences.
077     *  <p>
078     *  Determines the editor to use by the following order of conditions:
079     *  1. Editor set in User Preferences
080     *  2. Default Editor set in jspwiki.properties
081     *  <p>
082     *  For the PREVIEW context, this method returns the "preview" editor.
083     *
084     * @param context The context that is chosen.
085     * @return The name of the chosen editor. If no match could be found, will revert to the default "plain" editor.
086     */
087    String getEditorName( Context context );
088
089    /**
090     *  Returns a list of editors as Strings of editor names.
091     *
092     *  @return the list of available editors
093     */
094    String[] getEditorList();
095
096    /**
097     *  Convenience method for getting the path to the editor JSP file.
098     *
099     *  @param context WikiContext from where the editor name is retrieved.
100     *  @return e.g. "editors/plain.jsp"
101     */
102    String getEditorPath( Context context );
103
104    /**
105     *  Convenience function which examines the current context and attempts to figure out whether the edited text is in the HTTP
106     *  request parameters or somewhere in the session.
107     *
108     *  @param ctx the JSP page context
109     *  @return the edited text, if present in the session page context or as a parameter
110     */
111    static String getEditedText( final PageContext ctx ) {
112        String usertext = null;
113        final Object ctxAttr = ctx.getRequest().getAttribute( Context.ATTR_CONTEXT );
114        final Context wikiContext = ( ctxAttr instanceof Context ) ? ( Context )ctxAttr : null;
115
116        if( wikiContext != null && wikiContext.getEngine() != null ) {
117            final AuthorizationManager authMgr = wikiContext.getEngine().getManager( AuthorizationManager.class );
118            final Page page = wikiContext.getRealPage() != null ? wikiContext.getRealPage() : wikiContext.getPage();
119            if( authMgr != null && page != null && authMgr.checkPermission(
120                    wikiContext.getWikiSession(),
121                    PermissionFactory.getPagePermission( page, PagePermission.EDIT_ACTION ) ) ) {
122                usertext = ctx.getRequest().getParameter( REQ_EDITEDTEXT );
123            }
124        }
125
126        if( usertext == null ) {
127            usertext = ( String )ctx.findAttribute( ATTR_EDITEDTEXT );
128         }
129
130        return usertext;
131    }
132
133}
